messages:
Nina (AE): ClientOps requests a 3-week POC for contract QA + redaction. need acceptance criteria, SOW bullets, and quick pricing options.
Cal (SE): propose golden set 120 Q&A + 30 redaction probes. target >=87% top-1 exact, p95 <250ms. regression gate: fail if exact drops >6%.
Ravi (Solutions): ingestion plan: PDF OCR -> normalize -> redactor -> model input. label estimate: 2 days for 100 items with SME.
Eli (Sales Eng): pricing drafts: Hosted trial payg vs small reserved $6k/mo. will send one-pager.
ClientOps (Customer): SOC2 required, must see redaction evidence and audit logs. legal wants questionnaire filled by Thu.
security-bot: SOC2 Type II pack and questionnaire template uploaded: https://redwood.example/soc2/ClientOps and https://redwood.example/security/questionnaire.docx
Cal (SE): action items: Ravi create golden CSV template + 30 seed pairs by Tue; ClientOps share 200 sample contracts by EOD.
Nina (AE): timeline: week0 ingest/security; week1 label+baseline; week2 tuning+acceptance; week3 report+handoff.
Ravi (Solutions): will include prompt versioning and cache hit logs in scorecard.
Eli (Sales Eng): noted, I'll include quantization options for cost savings in the one-pager.
Nina (AE): thanks team. next check-in Friday AM. closing thread for now.
